svg.title: 06 Stop points, surviving effects and retries
svg.desc: Detailed execution call cards in reading order. Each card shows inputs, transformations and persistence. Dashed cards are assumed connections. Branches and alternatives are explicitly labeled. Read the linked Markdown for all field contracts and errors.
svg.text: 06 Stop points, surviving effects and retries
White outline = implemented function / AWS configuration • Dashed orange = assumed adapter
Read numbered cards in order; follow the explicit branch labels. Full field and failure contracts are in 06-failures-and-wiring.md.

g.text: F1 Reject before domain writes
MISSING HEADER / BAD JSON / BAD SCHEMA HTTP 400
BAD SIGNATURE 401; unavailable GitHub secret 500
UNSUPPORTED / NONCOMMAND 202 without dispatch
SURVIVES selected operational logs only
F2 Request insert fails
CAUSE missing table / duplicate / AWS write failure
HTTP 500; no Scheduler or PutEvents call follows
SURVIVES existing item on duplicate; ambiguous writes possible
RETRY duplicate intake is rejected, not resumed
F3 Schedule creation fails after insert
HTTP 500; provisioning publication is skipped
SURVIVES request; possible schedule on ambiguous failure
NO rollback or dispatch checkpoint
RETRY same delivery fails insert before schedule step
F4 Provision publication fails after schedule
HTTP 500; provision acceptance may be ambiguous
SURVIVES request and timeout schedule
NO cancel, outbox, archive or stored event ID
SUCCESS ELSEWHERE later destinations have separate outcomes
F5 Reserved token but allocation/record fails
SURVIVES journal; EC2 instance may already exist
RETRY RunInstances with same token + compatible parameters
RECOVER paginated client-token lookup → record ID
NO new deadline on retry; no automatic rollback
F6 Saved identity versus missing observations
SAVED ID delete bypasses discovery
NO ID + EMPTY LOOKUP delete returns undefined
MULTIPLE IDS discovery throws invariant error
SWEEP tagged expired workers can still be handled
F7 Cleanup tracking failure versus EC2 failure
TRACKING FAILURE still request tagged-worker termination
TERMINATE FAILURE append failed; continue other IDs
PAGE FAILURE abort sweep; earlier terminations remain
HTTP aggregate/generic 500 does not undo AWS actions
F8 Completion does not erase tracking
ACCEPTED TERMINATE not proof of finished deletion
NO waiter, resource status persistence or request deletion
RETAIN launch identity prevents a fresh create branch
VERIFY local mocked tests; no live deployment assertion
